summary.headline: Horary Timing and Fulfillment
summary.text: Horary rules for judging possession of the king’s substance and determining when the matter will be fulfilled. Timing is calculated from applications, receptions, light projection, conjunctions, angular strength, and a planet’s emergence from the Sun’s rays, with Venus introduced among the lighter stars.
